# `bit_get`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
bit_get(expr, pos)
```

Returns the value of the bit (0 or 1) at the specified position.
The positions are numbered from right to left, starting at zero.
The position argument cannot be negative.

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `bitwise_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 3.2.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 2 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- bit_get, example 1
> SELECT bit_get(11, 0);
1
```

```sql
-- bit_get, example 2
> SELECT bit_get(11, 2);
0
```
